name: NGC 7713 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7713, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc7713-hubble
story: A barred spiral in Sculptor, caught as part of Hubble's effort to image every known nearby galaxy deeply enough to pick out its brightest stars one by one.

claims.text: NGC 7713 is a barred spiral galaxy (type SBcd)
It was observed in program 15922, 'Every Known Nearby Galaxy', which aims to image nearby galaxies deeply enough to resolve their brightest stars
